g.text: Symmetric games form a two-dimensional phase space
R = 1, P = 0. Red: Nash boundaries. Dotted: payoff-order boundaries.
Blue dashed: group-payoff boundaries S + T = 0 and 2. Star: normalized baseline.
Analytic reconstruction using the repository engine; no model calls.
